goal: Eliminate false-positive human user_resume and review_without_verdict counts in /immune-brain:revisit by marking synthetic Claude hook, bash-output, and user-interrupt frames as synthetic: true and recognizing non-error CliReviewHost submit_review completions in session_evidence.ts, per D4 of docs/specs/workflow-friction-simplification.spec.md.

acceptance.assertion: Source BR-REQ-4; meet D4.1-D4.2 and BR-SCN-4 in docs/specs/workflow-friction-simplification.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/review-retro-analyzer.test.ts. Done looks like: Claude session user frames beginning with "Stop hook feedback:", "<bash-stdout>", or "<bash-stderr>", or equaling "[Request interrupted by user]", are classified synthetic: true and excluded from human user_resume chains, and CliReviewHost submit_review tool completions with is_error !== true and a completed review state are not counted under review_without_verdict. Negative: genuine human plain-text follow-ups (such as "继续") after non-error assistant turns still count as user_resume, and submit_review calls with is_error: true, rejected/blocked/review_incomplete states, or legacy Review subagent calls missing a verdict still count as review_without_verdict.
